maya: Heads-up — after the autotuner rollout from yesterday I'm seeing 20–30% increase in p95 latency on T4s for seqlen 512 traces. Thought it was batching but profile shows kernel switch churn.

sam: Can you paste the kernel-selection log for a sample trace? Did the tuner pick the fused-attn kernel or the generic matmul path?

maya: Here's an example trace:
```
[2026-03-16T22:10:05Z] model=redwood-7b v=20260315-driver=v2.1
seqlen=512 batch=1 chosen_kernel=fused_attn_v2 heuristic_score=0.72
later: seqlen=512 batch=1 chosen_kernel=matmul_generic heuristic_score=0.51
```
Looks like it flipped mid-request when KV cache hit/miss changed.

ollie: If the autotuner key doesn't include model weight sha or cache-tag, different model variants could reuse cached tuning results incorrectly. Our key is currently `model_name|driver_version|hw_type|seqlen_bucket`.

jen: We also didn't persist tuner metadata across driver restarts unless you opt-in. That means after a crash/restart we re-eval kernels and can hit bad choices for heavy tails.

maya: perf-bot saved a flamegraph for the problematic run:
perf-bot: CPU 12% | GPU compute 61% | kernel-switch overhead 7% | kernel-setup 20%

sam: Two quick asks:
1) Add model sha to autotune cache key (short-term)
2) Add an "affinity" tag: prefer last-successful-kernel for same model+seqlen unless regression observed (with decay TTL)

ollie: Agree. Also propose persisting tuner decisions to objectstore with versioned keys: `tuner/v1/{model_sha}/{hw}/{seqlen_bucket}` plus metadata JSON. TTL of 7d by default, adjustable per-customer.

jen: For invalidation: when a new driver binary is deployed we should bump key version (we already include driver_version but we need to detect kernel ABI changes). Maybe driver can expose `tuner_incompatible_change: true` in release notes to force invalidation.

maya: Another wrinkle — KV cache hits affect seqlen semantics (cached prefix shortens effective seqlen). Need the tuner to be aware of cached-prefix distribution, not just request seqlen. We should include `effective_seqlen` metric in the key.

sam: Good point. Could compute effective_seqlen = request_seqlen - avg_cached_prefix_len for model-session. Use histogram across sessions.

perf-bot: Profiling suggestion: record `kernel_choice_history` per request (small log) and aggregate flips per model+seqlen. Alert if flip rate > 2%.

jen: Ops: rolling back the tuner in canary for T4s now to previous config. @deploy-bot can you pin canary to old-tuner for the rest of day?

deploy-bot: Canary pinned to old-tuner for pool=t4-canary until 2026-03-17T06:00Z. :white_check_mark:

maya: I'll sketch a PR with changes to cache keying and persistence API. Expect draft by EOD. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ollie: If you want I can prototype the key format and a migration script to backfill persisted decisions for hot models.

maya: Please — that would speed this up.

jen: Great thread. Keep quick updates here.
